reason: The cited evidence discusses general strengthening mechanisms in HEAs (E1, E3) and density/strength trade-offs in Al-containing alloys (E2), but none provides specific data on alloying HfMoTaTiZr with Al or Ti, nor on retaining a single BCC phase or high-temperature properties in this system. The premises are thus largely unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Lighter elements like Al or Ti can be alloyed into HfMoTaTiZr to reduce density
The alloyed material will retain a single-phase BCC solid solution
Solid solution strengthening will maintain strength
Grain boundary strengthening will contribute to strength retention
Mechanical properties will be preserved from room temperature to 1000 °C
